selection.sides: Supplied Copy A and Copy B, with no inferred chronology or current approval
selection.same_load: Require exact same nonempty string load ID; differing IDs refuse before output creation
selection.input_contract: Exact five unique native v1 ZIP members, content-bound by the existing manifest, evidence digest, packet digest and review digest
selection.row_contract: Exact canonical native JSON record identity, preserving multiplicity and JSON distinctions such as false versus zero
selection.output_contract: Complete self-contained HTML created exclusively only after both inputs validate and report rendering finishes; supplied packet/index HTML never executed or injected; no source reprocessing or review action

decisive_cases.name: same-copy
decisive_cases.expect: All six sections have zero A-only/B-only records; identical evidence/review/packet identities; no inferred later copy

decisive_cases.name: departure-and-stale-review
decisive_cases.expect: One A-only old stop and one B-only new stop retain tracking.csv:row7, copied old approval stays recorded stale in B, packet digest changes

decisive_cases.name: multiplicity
decisive_cases.expect: Three identical stop records in A and one in B produce two A-only occurrences and one unchanged occurrence; another identical literal stop stays unchanged

decisive_cases.name: typed-literal-values
decisive_cases.expect: Exact records containing amount 0, false and null remain three distinct unchanged records; nested unknown fields, markup, Unicode, newline, note/history and surrogate text are preserved as escaped data

decisive_cases.name: refusals
decisive_cases.expect: Malformed member/schema/digest/selected-load or mismatched load refuses before output; existing output file remains untouched
